scheme_name: Financial Aid For Providing Hostel Facility To Transgender Students
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Kerala
Transgender students pursuing courses in Government, Aided, Un‑aided or Self‑financing institutions are eligible
Applicants must submit a new application at the commencement of each academic year
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹4,000 per month is provided as rent for hostel facilities to eligible transgender students.
